Before observation or mutation the existing principal/capability and typed SAF authority must authorize the command. A reviewed command name or fixture identity is not permission (docs/architecture/PLUGIN-AND-SECURITY.md).

Official row 0035 is the list variant: require POOLLIST with POOLNUM. Complete shared-body selector options are retained, but exclusive selectors plus the row-required form prohibit accepting the other variant through this row. Never merge official rows by shared EIBFN or source bytes.
POOL is eight characters; POOLLIST is contiguous eight-character names and POOLNUM is fullword 1..256 for the list variant.

SERVSTATUS accepts INSERVICE/OUTSERVICE or one bare alias. INSERVICE allows conversation use; OUTSERVICE prohibits new conversations but leaves existing ones running, with GOINGOUT until they end. Omission leaves service state unchanged. USERDATA optionally replaces 64 opaque characters.
mutations: Apply the same requested state to every selected list item; command returns immediately while settings may be attained later [primary parser lines 8-12].
Replace USERDATA only when present; preserve omitted service/acquire fields. Keep the requested service/acquire transition distinct from USERDATA replacement and eventual asynchronous work.
recovery_obligations: The reviewed bodies do not establish implicit syncpoint, caller-UOW rollback, compensation, task-end/abend or region/process restart semantics. Leave them unresolved; do not assume caller rollback removes successful list items.

Use existing CICS state/provider ownership and canonical effect identity, finite deadline, live cancellation, fenced replay and explicit post-dispatch UnknownOutcome. Never automatically redispatch a mutation to resolve uncertainty. These are repository integration obligations, not IBM restart evidence (docs/architecture/EXECUTION-AND-DURABILITY.md; docs/contracts/EFFECT-CANONICAL-V1.md; docs/contracts/TRANSACTION-PARTICIPANT-V1.md).

Manager must define bounded state codecs/version compatibility, migration/downgrade, retention, backup/restore and concurrent snapshot/transition rules in the existing provider store. This contract installs no store namespace or recovered pass (docs/contracts/PROVIDER-ROW-PERSISTENCE-V1.md; docs/contracts/DURABLE-STORAGE-PROFILE.md).

Admission/completion of the command does not prove eventual state attainment. A failure of later initiated work cannot retroactively become its synchronous exception: use the documented TD diagnostic and CSZL message path. [SSJL4D_6.x/reference-applications/commands-fepi/dfhp7k4.html sha256:ceb549cbc97f724aab9d489ec464d708d45e487d38e6479703de507d2d726712 parser lines 112-121; cics-fepi-context-candidates; baseline ibm-cics-ts-6x-fepi-context-candidates-2026-09-12]

Route actual event kinds: CSZX receives ACQFAIL, DISCARDFAIL, INSTALLFAIL, SESSION and SETFAIL; the pool EXCEPTIONQ receives ADDFAIL, DELETEFAIL, SESSIONFAIL and SESSIONLOST. No EXCEPTIONQ means no pool record; an absent or recoverable appropriate TD queue loses the record. TD is not durable audit. [SSJL4D_6.x/reference-applications/commands-fepi/dfhp73i.html sha256:84bb27ff6cf3b282754001015db6c4d871c872e4687ceab8c456f31af1e5f3b1 parser lines 10-15,91-147; cics-fepi-context-candidates; baseline ibm-cics-ts-6x-fepi-context-candidates-2026-09-12]

ACQFAIL EVENTVALUE is zero; DISCARDFAIL/INSTALLFAIL/SETFAIL values use the corresponding command RESP2. Session failure/loss values are 182..199. A nonzero acquire/session failure count means retry; zero means no further retry. Exact retry thresholds/timing are unstated.
